values.value: Reconcile Quote vs Order variance on Quote {primaryRecordId}

1. Open Quote {primaryRecordId}; Net Amount was {quoteNetAmount} but related Order(s) total {orderTotal} ({direction} by {delta}). 2. List Order(s): {orderIds}. Inspect each OrderItem and compare with the source Quote Line. 3. Identify which line(s) drifted — typical causes: Q→O field mapping dropped a custom price field, an Order Apex trigger rewrote pricing, or a manual edit after activation. 4. Either correct the Order pricing (with finance / billing approval) OR void + re-create from a fresh quote. 5. Audit your Q→O field map and any Order triggers/Flows. Add tests if you have a CI pipeline.
